visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot focuses on a large, seasoned black iron wok resting on a commercial gas stove. A person's hand, partially visible in a white uniform, uses a folded white cloth to wipe the interior with oil. Large text overlays in yellow and white frames introduce the segment. (2) The person carefully pours vibrant yellow egg liquid from a small stainless steel bowl into the center of the wok using a ladle. In the background, another individual in a white chef's shirt is busy at a different station in the brightly lit commercial kitchen. (3) The person lifts the heavy wok by its dual metal handles and tilts it in a circular motion, causing the liquid egg to spread toward the edges. Instructional text appears at the top. (4) As the egg sheet begins to set but appears uneven, the person adds small droplets of fresh egg liquid from the bowl to patch the thin or broken edges. (5) Using a metal spatula and their bare fingers, the person gently lifts the edge of the thin egg sheet and flips it over. The sheet is pale yellow and slightly textured. (6) The person holds the completed, circular egg sheet aloft on the spatula for a female instructor to see. She is wearing a black chef's uniform and a white hat, smiling and nodding in a clean, professional kitchen environment with stainless steel counters.
